context: A teacher pep-talks a teen who is doubting her abilities
purpose: Teach: 兼/収め/カッコ/役に立つ/世界一/珍しく/的確/なるべく

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生…私、なんだか自信なくて。世界一になりたいなんて言わないけど、自分が情けないんです。
lines.en: Sensei... I just don't have any confidence. I'm not saying I want to be world's best, but I feel pathetic.
lines.style: Soft hesitant teen voice, trailing off with vulnerable, slightly tearful tone

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、珍しく弱気ね。あなたは生徒会長兼バスケ部のキャプテンでしょう?
lines.en: Sakura-san, it's unusual for you to be so meek. You're the student council president and basketball team captain, right?
lines.style: Warm teacher voice, gentle but firm, slightly surprised and caring

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でも肩書きだけで…的確な判断もできないし、みんなの役に立つ気がしないんです。
lines.en: But those are just titles... I can't make accurate decisions, and I don't feel like I'm useful to anyone.
lines.style: Discouraged teenage tone, self-deprecating, voice quiet and uncertain throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 去年の大会で優勝を収めたのは誰?あなたのチームよ。それは立派な実績じゃない。
lines.en: Who won the championship at last year's tournament? Your team. That's a splendid achievement, isn't it?
lines.style: Encouraging teacher voice, reminding her with warm conviction and pride

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あれはたまたまで…先輩たちがカッコよくて、私はただ付いていっただけなんです。
lines.en: That was just a coincidence... the seniors were cool, and I just tagged along with them.
lines.style: Self-doubting teen voice, brushing off compliments, sounding embarrassed and unsure

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いい?そんなふうに自分を低く見積もるのはやめなさい。なるべく自分の良いところを見るのよ。
lines.en: Listen, stop underestimating yourself like that. Try as much as you can to see your own good points.
lines.style: Firm motherly teacher tone, leaning in, voice steady and convincing throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: …先生にそう言ってもらえると、何だか前を向ける気がします。ありがとうございます。
lines.en: ...When you say that to me, sensei, somehow I feel like I can face forward. Thank you so much.
lines.style: Slowly brightening teen voice, relief and gratitude breaking through softly
